Who I Am

About Me

I'm Chahat Kansal — a writer, strategist, and finance aspirant based in Ghaziabad, India. My background spans content creation, social media management, nonprofit fundraising, and team leadership.

I've interned at InAmigos Foundation, Pledge A Smile Foundation, and ArjaVA — where I progressed from intern to a managerial role. Outside of professional work, I've written 100+ poems in English and Hindi, and I'm completing my debut novel Who Am I?

I'm currently pursuing the ACCA qualification alongside my BBA (Hons) at SCMS Noida — working toward a long-term goal of an MBA at the intersection of finance, strategy, and storytelling.

Mission

To build financially independent, impact-driven work that fuses analytical rigour with creative excellence — helping organisations communicate with precision and purpose.

Vision

To become a globally recognised finance and strategy professional who never stops writing — carrying both a spreadsheet and a notebook into every room.

Content Volunteer · InAmigos Foundation · June–July 2026

Content WritingSocial ImpactInAmigos Foundation
Project Bachpanshala
InAmigos Foundation — Content Writing Internship
In our country, some children go to bed each night without having read a single word that day. It's not that they don't want to learn — it's simply that no one has created a space for them to do so.

That's where Project Bachpanshala, run by the InAmigos Foundation, steps in. Through hands-on, volunteer-led sessions, Bachpanshala offers free education, creative learning, and heartfelt support to kids in underserved communities. No fees, no prerequisites — just a strong belief that every child deserves a childhood filled with curiosity, growth, and endless possibilities.

With over 500 children positively impacted, this initiative is entirely powered by individuals who chose to make a difference. I had the privilege of being a content volunteer, and what moved me wasn't just the scale of the work but the genuine intention behind it.

This is what grassroots impact truly looks like. If you believe education should be a right, not a privilege — please share this post.
#InAmigos #ProjectBachpanshala #NGO #ChildrensEducation #ContentWriting #SocialImpact #GrassrootsChange #VolunteerWork #EducationForAll #India

What is Community Engagement?

An active process involving the community in planning, execution, and evaluation of initiatives that affect them.

  • Strengthens company-community relationships
  • Creates loyalty and public support
  • Enhances organisational reputation

Why It Matters

  • Builds trust and positive reputation
  • Understands community needs & expectations
  • Provides valuable feedback
  • Increases visibility and attractiveness

Words I've Written

Writing Samples

Published Poem · Student Corner, School Newspaper
I Need You to Celebrate the Days
When you were in a war with yourself
But you didn't let it show
Coz you know this is your battle

The days when your pillow was all wet
Coz the streams of tears wasn't coming to an end
And the days when there were no tears
But still you felt shattered inside

I need you to celebrate the days
When the path beside you was faded
But you didn't stop trying your best
The days when you were not yourself
But you gathered up all your courage
And fought the best war you can

But trust me if you are still fighting
So just continue
Coz Darling one day you will get through
And celebrate these days in your way too.

Published in Student Corner · Credited as Chahat Kansal, XI-A, DPSGI, Ghaziabad
